name: Silo Pipeline

Length passes the 15.5 mile rule. Only one source: EIA is one origin, and web search was unavailable this session so no FERC order or operator release was pulled to pair with it. Pair with the FERC CP15-26 order before applying. Exact endpoints are not stated. Owner spelled as EIA gives it; no legal form found. PipelineType is a guess from the lateral label; Capacity is EIA's additional capacity, which equals total for a new line.
